Published August 11, 2026 4:06 PM · EL PASO, Texas (KVIA) -- Circle K is bringing back a fuel discount to its pumps Thursday. Inner Circle Members can get up to 40 cents off each gallon of gas at some El Paso locations, a spokesperson said. From 12:01 a.m. to 11:59 p.m., members can redeem the discount at the pump or inside a Circle K store checkout. Circle K said customers must be a registered member. If you're not an Inner Circle member, the company said customers can sign up for free by downloading the Circle K app. You can also text JOIN to 25050.
